sections.title: Technology Campus and Office Demand Analytics
sections.description: For the commercial real estate firms serving Amazon, Microsoft, Google, and Seattle's large tech campus market.

blocks.heading: Tech employment and campus demand ML
paragraphs: ML linking technology employment signals to commercial real estate demand — predicting which Seattle submarkets will see increased demand from technology company hiring cycles, campus expansion announcements, and corporate real estate commitments. Amazon's HQ2 announcements, Microsoft's suburban Redmond campus expansion decisions, and Google's Kirkland and Seattle leasing activities move Puget Sound commercial real estate markets in ways that are partially predictable from employment data and corporate signals.

blocks.heading: Bellevue office market analytics
paragraphs: ML for the Bellevue, Washington office market — Amazon's large Bellevue presence (Amazon chose Bellevue for its second urban campus) has created a specific Bellevue office market analytics opportunity for the landlords and investors managing the rapid office inventory expansion east of Lake Washington.

blocks.heading: Life sciences commercial real estate analytics
paragraphs: ML for the growing Seattle life sciences real estate sector — Seattle's large biotech community (including Fred Hutchinson, the Allen Institute for Brain Science, and the growing IPO-stage biotechs in South Lake Union) is creating a Cambridge-like life sciences real estate analytics demand in Seattle.

sections.title: Puget Sound Residential Analytics
sections.description: Seattle's residential market is defined by extreme tech-salary-driven price appreciation and fierce constraint.

blocks.heading: Seattle-Bellevue residential AVM
paragraphs: ML for automated valuation in the extraordinarily heterogeneous Seattle metro — from Capitol Hill condos to Mercer Island estates to Eastside Bellevue single-family to South Seattle diverse multifamily, the price per square foot variation across Seattle's neighborhoods creates AVM challenges that require neighborhood-level modeling.

blocks.heading: Tech worker demand forecasting
paragraphs: ML for predicting the home-buying demand from Seattle's large tech worker population — corporate hiring cycles at Amazon (Puget Sound's largest private employer with 50,000+ Seattle-area employees), Microsoft (Redmond HQ, 45,000+ Seattle-area employees), and other tech employers are predictive of residential demand waves that create actionable signals for the residential market participants who can see them early.

blocks.heading: Washington Privacy Act-compliant consumer real estate
paragraphs: Washington's consumer privacy law applies to residential consumer data in real estate analytics — ClickMasters designs Seattle residential real estate AI with WA Privacy Act compliance.

sections.title: Pacific Northwest Multifamily Analytics
sections.description: For the large apartment REITs and real estate investors managing Seattle and Pacific Northwest multifamily.

blocks.heading: Puget Sound multifamily demand forecasting
paragraphs: ML for the Pacific Northwest's multifamily market — the combination of Seattle's rent control advocacy (Seattle's strong tenant protection movement), the Just Cause Eviction ordinance, and the market dynamics of one of the US's most supply-constrained apartment markets creates analytics requirements specific to Seattle's regulatory environment.

blocks.heading: Airbnb and short-term rental analytics
paragraphs: ML for the short-term rental dynamics of Seattle's tourist and business travel market — forecasting STR demand, pricing optimization for STR operators, and the regulatory analytics for Seattle's short-term rental licensing and hosting restrictions.

sections.title: Affordable Housing Analytics (Seattle's Housing Crisis)
sections.description: Seattle's housing affordability crisis — median home price exceeding $850,000 — has created significant civic and nonprofit investment in housing analytics.

blocks.heading: Seattle MHA and inclusionary zoning analytics
paragraphs: ML for the Mandatory Housing Affordability (MHA) program impact — analyzing the commercial impact of Seattle's MHA zoning upzones and affordable housing fees on development feasibility for the developers navigating Seattle's complex inclusionary housing framework.

blocks.heading: Community land trust and affordable housing preservation
paragraphs: ML for the organizations working to preserve affordable housing in Seattle's rapidly gentrifying neighborhoods — identifying housing at risk of conversion from affordable to market-rate, predicting which preservation interventions have the highest impact.
